currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific existing Estadio Centenario in neutral football configuration: own native asymmetric bowl/four stands, three blue-pale seating banks/closed concourse belts/neutral portal faces/pale radial dividers, paved apron/open neutral field/goals, native central America canopy/press gallery/posts and frame, masonry exterior/visible supports, four tall inward-facing floodlights/neutral supported end displays and Torre de los Homenajes. The tower retains mapped shaft/spine/buttress plans with stepped top, vertical flutes/side recesses and nine ledges, a slim upper spine/pole and small blue-white striped flag without emblem. No future redevelopment, event/crowd/artwork/lettering/inscriptions, unique texture or furnished hidden rooms.
